about: editor-gui's application mutants (wf10 corpus wave GP2a, GP2b): edits of the example, each with the law or the test that kills it. A killer examples/editor-gui/PKG:law L is `ergo test examples/editor-gui/PKG --law L`; scripts/examples:editor-gui is the program's cases, killed when a case's output differs; cmd/ergo:TestEditorGuiAgreesWithControl is the seeded agreement property against the plain reference model and the hand Go control, which kills the mutants no law sees.

mutants.name: editor-undo-makes-the-edit-again
mutants.rule: Undo makes each edit's inverse, last first.

mutants.name: editor-change-skips-its-last-edit
mutants.rule: A change makes every one of its edits.

mutants.name: editor-wrote-leaves-it-dirty
mutants.from: Window{..w, Ed: edit.After(w.Ed, edit.Saved), Writing: None}
mutants.rule: The end of a save tells the editor Saved.

mutants.name: editor-failed-save-counts-as-saved
mutants.from: Emit[Window, Note]{Next: Window{..w, Writing: None}, Output: CannotSave
mutants.to: Emit[Window, Note]{Next: Window{..w, Ed: edit.After(w.Ed, edit.Saved), Writing: None}, Output: CannotSave
mutants.rule: A save that fails leaves the edits unsaved.

mutants.name: editor-ctrl-home-goes-home
mutants.from: Some{Value: Do{Signal: if ctrl { edit.Top } else { edit.Home }}}
mutants.rule: Ctrl+Home goes to the text's start.

mutants.name: editor-caret-painted-from-the-text-start
mutants.rule: The page lays out the shown lines, so the caret is where it is in them.

mutants.name: editor-selection-painted-unclipped
mutants.from: for r in ui.SelectionRects(Mono, l, lo-from, hi-from) {
mutants.to: for r in ui.SelectionRects(Mono, l, lo, hi) {
mutants.rule: The selection is painted where the shown lines hold it.

mutants.name: editor-scene-presses-one-key-short
mutants.rule: A move of N is N presses of its arrow.

mutants.name: editor-scene-reports-no-save
mutants.rule: After each line the host settles, so a save the view asked for runs and its end shows.

mutants.name: editor-piece-grows-any-added-piece
mutants.from: if pos == end && isAdded(p) && p.Start+p.Size == start {
mutants.rule: Typing grows a piece only when the piece ends where the added buffer ends.

mutants.name: editor-piece-delete-keeps-the-wrong-tail
mutants.from: Start: p.Start + (hi - offset), Size: end - hi
mutants.to: Start: p.Start + (hi - lo), Size: end - hi
mutants.rule: A delete keeps the bytes of a piece after the cut.

mutants.name: editor-added-breaks-lose-their-base
mutants.rule: The line index holds a break's offset in its buffer.

mutants.name: editor-below-counts-the-equal
mutants.rule: A piece's breaks start at its first byte, not after it.

mutants.name: editor-undo-of-insert-inserts
mutants.rule: The inverse of an insert deletes the inserted text.

mutants.name: editor-matches-overlap
mutants.rule: Replace replaces the matches strings.ReplaceAll finds, none overlapping.

mutants.name: editor-search-escape-keeps-the-match
mutants.rule: Escape from a search puts the caret back where the search started.

mutants.name: editor-selection-escape-stays
mutants.rule: Escape ends a selection.

mutants.name: editor-next-steps-past-no-match
mutants.rule: Next with no match anywhere leaves the caret where it is.

mutants.name: editor-bottom-past-the-end
mutants.rule: The caret stays inside the text.

mutants.name: editor-down-writes-up
mutants.rule: A command's line reads back as the command.

mutants.name: editor-shelf-saves-another-text
mutants.rule: A saved text is the text that loads.

mutants.name: editor-undo-puts-the-caret-after
mutants.rule: Undo puts the caret where it was before the change.

mutants.name: editor-edit-keeps-redo
mutants.to: Undo: d.Undo.Append(c), Redo: d.Redo, Dirty: true}
mutants.rule: A new change clears what redo would make again.

mutants.name: editor-replace-puts-the-caret-back
mutants.rule: After a replace the caret is at the first replaced match.

mutants.name: editor-selection-type-lands-at-the-end
mutants.rule: Typing over a selection leaves the caret after the typed text.

mutants.name: editor-back-misses-four-byte-runes
mutants.rule: Back erases a whole rune, four bytes long too.

mutants.name: editor-line-move-drifts-a-column
mutants.from: Forward(d, start, Column(d, d.Caret), piece.LineEnd(d.Buf, line))
mutants.to: Forward(d, start, Column(d, d.Caret)+1, piece.LineEnd(d.Buf, line))
mutants.rule: Up and down keep the caret's column.

mutants.name: editor-frame-shows-one-line-below
mutants.from: let last = if at+2 < lines { at + 2 } else { lines }
mutants.to: let last = if at+1 < lines { at + 1 } else { lines }
mutants.rule: A frame shows two lines below the caret's line.

mutants.name: editor-saved-stays-dirty
mutants.rule: A saved document is not dirty.

mutants.name: editor-invalid-offset-of-two-bytes
mutants.rule: A text that is not UTF-8 is refused with its first invalid byte.
